title: Stratifying moduli spaces of Higgs bundles and the Hitchin morphism
summary: We study the behavior of slope-stability of reflexive twisted sheaves over a normal projective variety $X$ under pullback along a cover. Slope-stability is always preserved if the cover does not factor via a quasi-étale cover. Fixing the rank, there is one quasi-étale cover that checks whether a twisted sheaf remains slope-stable on all Galois covers, yielding a stratification of the moduli space of slope-stable Higgs-bundles.
